integrity: Self-contained elementary proof with reproducible finite checks; prior universal bounds and squarefree-value results explicitly credited. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact result only for squarefree 4m(m+1)-1; no general height formula or assertion of infinitely many symmetric exceptional minimizers. Classical discriminant bound and quadratic squarefree-value theorem are prerequisites; an earlier equivalent extremizer classification may exist.
title: Exact coefficient heights and extremizers in a quadratic discriminant family
